A.claim: Level lowering in the style of Azon arXiv:2504.01967v2 Theorem 5.23 applies to the weighted equation X^10 + 256 Y^10 = Z^17 and eliminates the surviving Frey representation.

B.claim: Unified: if 3 | gcd(x,y,z) or 4 | gcd(x,y,z), then A^x + B^y = C^z has no positive solutions. Packages the 3|x,3|y,3|z family (FLT3) and the 4|x,4|y,z even family (not_fermat_42).
